headline: Australian Dollar Slides on Softer Than Expected Inflation
summary: The Australian dollar fell nearly 0.5% on Wednesday after Q2 CPI rose 3.9% from Q1, below the 4.1% forecast. The source also cites monthly data.
why: Inflation data shapes central bank rate expectations, and the Australian dollar is one of the main currencies traded against the US dollar.

impacts.name: Australian dollar
impacts.why: Softer inflation lowers expectations for tighter Reserve Bank of Australia policy, weighing on the currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Australian CPI came in below forecast, reducing expectations for tighter monetary policy and pushing the Australian dollar lower.
